plain: the system of charging people money to support government

webster.text: A taxing; the act of laying a tax, or of imposing taxes on the subjects of a state by government, or on the members of a corporation or company by the proper authority.

more.text: The act of taxing or assessing a bill of cost.

example.quote: The power of creating new funds upon new objects of taxation, by its own authority, would enable the national government to borrow as far as its necessities might require.
